staffing.source: Payroll-Based Journal (PBJ), as published by CMS

provenance.note: Five-Star ratings and PBJ staffing apply to the CMS-certified universe only.
Linked to the CMS record by the exact normalized facility name within the same ZIP (the state roster does not publish the CCN).

inspection_summary.window_note: CMS publishes about the three most recent standard surveys plus complaint and infection-control inspections from the prior three years. Older findings leave the dataset; their absence is not evidence they never happened.

cms-f0600.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
cms-f0600.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0689.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
cms-f0689.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0825.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0628.title: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

cms-k0345.title: Have approved installation, maintenance and testing program for fire alarm systems.

cms-k0908.title: Ensure gas and vacuum systems are inspected and tested as part of a maintenance program.
cms-k0908.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0923.title: Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.
cms-k0923.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-e0004.title: Develop and maintain an Emergency Preparedness Program (EP).

cms-k0291.title: Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.

cms-k0918.title: Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
cms-k0918.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0223.title: Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.

cms-f0812.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

cms-f0908.title: Keep all essential equipment working safely.

cms-f0558.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.

cms-f0656.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
cms-f0656.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0657.title: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.
cms-f0657.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

cms-f0690.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
cms-f0690.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0699.title: Provide care or services that was trauma informed and/or culturally competent.
cms-f0699.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0725.title: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.

cms-f0761.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

cms-f0602.title: Protect each resident from the wrongful use of the resident's belongings or money.
cms-f0602.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0684.title: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
cms-f0684.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0686.title: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.
cms-f0686.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0695.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
cms-f0695.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0745.title: Provide medically-related social services to help each resident achieve the highest possible quality of life.
cms-f0745.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0756.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

cms-f0790.title: Provide routine and 24-hour emergency dental care for each resident.
cms-f0790.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0844.title: Follow rules about disclosure of ownership requirements and tell the state agency about changes in ownership and/or administrative personnel.

cms-f0868.title: Have the Quality Assessment and Assurance group have the required members and meet at least quarterly

cms-f0883.title: Develop and implement policies and procedures for flu and pneumonia vaccinations.

cms-f0941.title: Develop, implement, and/or maintain an effective training program that includes effective communications for direct care staff members.

cms-f0942.title: Ensure that staff members are educated on resident rights and facility responsibilities to properly care for its residents.

cms-f0944.title: Conduct mandatory training, for all staff, on the facility’s Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Program.

cms-f0945.title: Include as part of its infection prevention and control program, mandatory training that includes written standards, policies, and procedures for the program.

cms-f0946.title: Provide training in compliance and ethics.

cms-f0947.title: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

cms-f0575.title: Post a list of names, addresses, and telephone numbers of all pertinent State agencies and advocacy groups and a statement that the resident may file a complaint with the State Survey Agency.

cms-f0565.title: Honor the resident's right to organize and participate in resident/family groups in the facility.

cms-f0610.title: Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
cms-f0610.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0760.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

cms-k0353.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.

cms-k0753.title: Have restrictions on the use of highly flammable decorations.

cms-f0622.title: Not transfer or discharge a resident without an adequate reason; and must provide documentation and convey specific information  when a resident is transferred or discharged.

cms-f0625.title: Notify the resident or the resident’s representative in writing how long the nursing home will hold the resident’s bed in cases of transfer to a hospital or therapeutic leave.

cms-f0693.title: Ensure that feeding tubes are  not used unless there is a medical reason and the resident agrees; and provide appropriate care for a resident with a feeding tube.
cms-f0693.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0730.title: Observe each nurse aide's job performance and give regular training.

cms-f0550.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.

cms-f0578.title: Honor the resident's right to request, refuse, and/or discontinue treatment, to participate in or refuse to participate in experimental research, and to formulate an advance directive.

cms-f0580.title: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

cms-f0582.title: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

cms-f0585.title: Honor the resident's right to voice grievances without discrimination or reprisal and the facility must establish a grievance policy and make prompt efforts to resolve grievances.

cms-f0626.title: Permit a resident to return to the nursing home after hospitalization or therapeutic leave that exceeds bed-hold policy.

cms-f0698.title: Provide safe, appropriate dialysis care/services for a resident who requires such services.
cms-f0698.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0742.title: Provide the appropriate treatment and services to a resident who displays or is diagnosed with mental disorder or psychosocial adjustment difficulty, or who has a history of trauma and/or post-traumatic stress disorder.
cms-f0742.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

cms-f0755.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.

cms-f0758.title: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

cms-f0805.title: Ensure each resident receives and the facility provides food prepared in a form designed to meet individual needs.

cms-f0809.title: Ensure meals and snacks are served at times in accordance with resident’s needs, preferences, and requests.  Suitable and nourishing alternative meals and snacks must be provided for residents who want to eat at non-traditional times or outside of scheduled meal times.

cms-f0810.title: Provide special eating equipment and utensils for residents who need them and appropriate assistance.

cms-f0880.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

cms-k0914.title: Ensure receptacles at patient bed locations and where general anesthesia is administered, are tested after initial installation, replacement or servicing.
cms-k0914.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0321.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.

cms-k0911.title: Meet requirements for the installation and maintenance of electrical systems.
cms-k0911.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-k0920.title: Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.
cms-k0920.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

cms-f0584.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

cms-f0583.title: Keep residents' personal and medical records private and confidential.

cms-f0607.title: Develop and implement policies and procedures to prevent abuse, neglect, and theft.
cms-f0607.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0609.title: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
cms-f0609.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

cms-f0726.title: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.

cms-f0838.title: Conduct and document a facility-wide assessment to determine what resources are necessary to care for residents competently during both day-to-day operations (including nights and weekends) and emergencies.

cms-f0867.title: Set up an ongoing quality assessment and assurance group to review quality deficiencies  and develop corrective plans of action.
